properties.title: Snap
properties.label: 1. Snap
properties.input: The survey's sidewalk corner is 0.57 m from the city's.
properties.result: Same type, within 1 m: the survey corner joins the city corner, which keeps its place and records ext:union_absorbed.

properties.title: Duplicate sidewalk removed
properties.label: 2. Duplicate sidewalk removed
properties.input: The survey traced 52 m of the south sidewalk again, 0.3 m off.
properties.result: Over 80 % of it lies within 1 m of the city's sidewalk, running the same way: removed. The city's line stays.

properties.title: Duplicate crossing removed
properties.label: 3. Duplicate crossing removed
properties.input: Both sources have the west crossing; the survey's is 0.4 m east, its kerbs 0.45 m from the city's.
properties.result: The survey copy is removed. Kerbs never move or merge, so its kerbs go with it and the city's crossing keeps its own.

properties.title: Duplicate road removed
properties.label: 4. Duplicate road removed
properties.input: The survey traced Harbor Blvd again; its nodes lie 0.36-0.39 m from the city's.
properties.result: The road nodes snap onto the city's, the copy then joins the same two nodes as a city edge, and is removed.

properties.title: New crossing meets the road
properties.label: 5. New crossing meets the road
properties.input: The survey's east crossing crosses Harbor Blvd with no shared node.
properties.result: road-crossing: one node where they cross; the crossing and the road are both split there.

properties.title: Kerb 0.4 m short of the sidewalk
properties.label: 6. Kerb 0.4 m short of the sidewalk
properties.input: The east crossing's north kerb stops 0.4 m short of the sidewalk.
properties.result: The kerb never moves. crossing-sidewalk puts a node on the sidewalk, splits it, and a 0.4 m connector joins the kerb to it.

properties.title: Kerb on the sidewalk
properties.label: 7. Kerb on the sidewalk
properties.input: The east crossing's south kerb lies exactly on the sidewalk line.
properties.result: Gap of zero: the sidewalk is split at the kerb, which becomes the junction. No connector.

properties.title: Kerbs at the same spot join
properties.label: 8. Kerbs at the same spot join
properties.input: The south crossing ends exactly on the kerb ramp the city recorded (no crossing in city data).
properties.result: Two kerbs join only when they coincide, as here: one node. The city's tactile_paving=no stays; the survey's 'yes' is audited, its ext:surveyed added.

properties.title: Crossing runs past the sidewalk
properties.label: 9. Crossing runs past the sidewalk
properties.input: The south crossing ends 0.5 m beyond the west sidewalk.
properties.result: Overshoot: they join where they cross; the crossing and the sidewalk are both split there.

properties.title: T-junction: shop path
properties.label: 10. T-junction: shop path
properties.input: A path from a shop door ends 0.6 m short of the south sidewalk.
properties.result: pedestrian-pedestrian: a node on the sidewalk, which is split, and a 0.6 m connector.

properties.title: Crossing lands on a living street
properties.label: 11. Crossing lands on a living street
properties.input: The Willow Lane crossing ends 0.5 m short of the living street, and crosses Harbor Blvd.
properties.result: crossing-living-street joins it to Willow Lane's end with a connector; road-crossing joins it to the road; its south kerb splits the sidewalk.

properties.title: Not joined: no rule asks
properties.label: 12. Not joined: no rule asks
properties.input: The south sidewalk passes over Market Alley.
properties.result: No default rule joins a sidewalk to a road, so neither is split there. The park path the city already joined to the north sidewalk stays as it was.

properties.title: Bench in both: merged
properties.label: 13. Bench in both: merged
properties.input: Both have the bench, 0.36 m apart; the survey also has a bin beside it.
properties.result: Same type within 1 m: one bench at the city's position, the survey's ext:condition added and its values audited. The bin is another type, so it stays apart.

properties.title: Street lamps 1.4 m apart
properties.label: 14. Street lamps 1.4 m apart
properties.input: Both have the street lamp at the corner; the survey's is 1.4 m from the city's.
properties.result: Same type, but more than 1 m apart: both lamps are kept. With extensions at 1.5 m or more they merge.

properties.title: Hydrant only in the survey
properties.label: 15. Hydrant only in the survey
properties.input: Only the survey has the fire hydrant.
properties.result: Nothing of its type nearby to merge with: it is added as it is.

properties.title: Fence traced twice: merged
properties.label: 16. Fence traced twice: merged
properties.input: Both have the fence south of Bayview Offices; the survey's is 0.3-0.4 m off and says it is wood.
properties.result: At least 70 % of the survey's line lies within 1 m of the city's: one fence, the city's line, with material=wood added.

properties.title: Harbor Hall in both: merged
properties.label: 17. Harbor Hall in both: merged
properties.input: Both have Harbor Hall; the survey's outline is about 0.5 m off and adds a storey count.
properties.result: The survey's outline covers more than 70 % of the city's: one building, the city's outline, with building:levels=2 added.

properties.title: Corner Shops: outlines joined
properties.label: 18. Corner Shops: outlines joined
properties.input: The survey outlined Corner Shops' back half and its new rear extension: 48 % of the city's outline.
properties.result: Overlapping, but under 70 %: one building whose outline is both shapes together, the city's tags first, building:levels added.

properties.title: Kiosk only in the survey
properties.label: 19. Kiosk only in the survey
properties.input: Only the survey has Willow Kiosk.
properties.result: It overlaps no city building: added as it is.

properties.title: Market Square (zone) in both
properties.label: 20. Market Square (zone) in both
properties.input: Both map the square as a pedestrian zone; the survey's is 1.5 m east and adds surface=paving_stones.
properties.result: The survey's zone covers more than 70 % of the city's: the city's zone is kept and the survey's dropped. A zone keeps the city's tags only, so surface is not added.
